headline: Google Unveils $17 Billion Investment for First Data Center in Wyoming
summary: Google announced a $17 billion investment to build its first data center in Wyoming, partnering with energy firms on a 702 MW fuel cell project utilizing carbon capture technology.
why: Massive capital expenditures in data center infrastructure reflect surging demand for cloud computing and AI workloads, while impacting regional energy markets.

impacts.name: Alphabet
impacts.why: Significant infrastructure spending demonstrates long-term commitment to cloud and AI expansion.
